user.title: Thermal zone
user.description: ATHB creates one Home Assistant device for each thermal zone. The device calculates adaptive comfort and can optionally control temperature targets.

data_description.name: Use a recognisable room or zone name.

environment.title: Room measurements
environment.description: Select the measurements that describe this zone. Measured humidity is recommended. A declared humidity value remains explicitly identified as declared data.

data_description.primary_temperature: Representative indoor air temperature for this zone.
data_description.rh_mode: Choose a measured entity or a fixed declared value.
data_description.outdoor_source: Outdoor temperature used for the persisted running mean; outdoor humidity is not an ATHB input.

humidity.title: Indoor humidity
humidity.description: Only the selected humidity source is shown. ATHB uses indoor humidity for comfort and surface diagnostics.

data_description.rh_entity: Entity reporting relative humidity in percent.
data_description.rh_declared: Fixed relative humidity from 0 to 100%. No sensor value is invented.

targets.title: Climate targets
targets.description: Choose one through eight existing climate entities. ATHB only sends temperature targets and never changes HVAC mode, power, fan, preset, swing or humidity.

data_description.targets: The thermostats or climate controllers whose temperature target ATHB may manage.

comfort.title: Comfort strategy
comfort.description: Balanced is the recommended default. Efficient allows more variation; Comfort keeps the target closer to thermal neutral. All three are solved directly in ATHB sensation space.

control.title: Control setup
control.description: The normal setup uses safe defaults and starts with adaptive control switched off. Select advanced settings only when you need custom limits or model parameters.

data_description.occupancy_entity: Optional entity used by the Auto profile.
data_description.advanced_settings: Show activity, air-speed, command-limit, fallback and override settings.

advanced_control.title: Advanced control settings
advanced_control.description: These settings change numerical assumptions or temperature-control safety limits. Keep the defaults unless you know the zone or actuator requires different values.

review.title: Review thermal zone
review.description:
**{zone}** will use `{primary}` and `{outdoor}` with {target_count} climate target(s). Comfort strategy: **{strategy}**.

ATHB will create one zone device. Adaptive control starts **off**, so the initial entities are previews until you deliberately enable it.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure thermal zone
reconfigure.description: Change the required measurement sources for this zone. The same zone identity and Home Assistant device are retained.

reconfigure_humidity.title: Indoor humidity
reconfigure_humidity.description: Only the selected humidity source is shown. Outdoor humidity is not an ATHB input.

reconfigure_targets.title: Climate targets
reconfigure_targets.description: Change the climate entities whose temperature targets ATHB may manage.

error.invalid_rh_source: Select exactly one valid humidity source.
error.invalid_targets: Select one through eight distinct climate targets.
error.target_not_registered: Every climate target must have an entity-registry identity.
error.target_already_controlled: Another enabled ATHB zone already controls this target.
error.invalid_control_bounds: The minimum must be below the maximum.
error.invalid_option: One or more options are outside their supported range.

abort.reconfigure_successful: The thermal zone configuration was updated successfully.

init.title: ATHB options
init.description: Common choices are shown first. Enable advanced settings only when you need scientific, source or actuator tuning.

radiant.title: Advanced radiant source
radiant.description: Choose the configured radiant source. Surface mode next asks whether its temperature is measured or modelled.

surface_details.title: Surface source
surface_details.description: Only fields required for the selected measured or modelled surface are shown.

removed_source_or_target.title: ATHB source or target was removed
removed_source_or_target.description: Reconfigure the zone and select an available source or target.

duplicate_target_ownership.title: Climate target is controlled by two ATHB zones
duplicate_target_ownership.description: Disable one zone or select a different target.

corrupt_control_storage.title: ATHB control recovery data is corrupt
corrupt_control_storage.description: Review the zone and press Resume before enabling commands.

persistent_target_rejection.title: Climate target repeatedly rejected ATHB commands
persistent_target_rejection.description: Check the target capability, bounds and grid.

incompatible_auto_mapping.title: Automatic HVAC mode has no supported ATHB mapping
incompatible_auto_mapping.description: Configure an explicit supported mapping or select a supported HVAC mode.

missing_history_24h.title: ATHB outdoor history remains unavailable
missing_history_24h.description: Check the outdoor source and Recorder availability.

mandatory_input_unavailable_1h.title: A mandatory ATHB input remains unavailable
mandatory_input_unavailable_1h.description: Restore the selected temperature or humidity source.
